caption:
Hiring a social media marketing agency should mean your content runs without you.

We work with you month to month. You show up on camera a few hours a month, we handle everything else.

DM me TEAM and I'll send you a link to talk about your content.
why: The video explains what hiring Joseph gets you, which is done-for-you content every month, so TEAM is the right CTA, and the numbers are gone because he only gave a loose range of hours.
